title: Fabulous Kids T-Shirt for Fun and Stylish Outfits
meta_description: Discover our fabulous kids t-shirt, designed for comfort and style. Perfect for playtime or everyday wear, it adds fun to any wardrobe.
heading: Fabulous kids t-shirt

messages: Self fabric neck tape (inside, back of the neck)

description.html:
Every trendsetter needs the perfect t-shirt! Our resident fashionista, Oz, thought you might like this one… a spectacular print of our leading lady, this tee is the ultimate accessory for any fabulous fashionista.

• Fabric weight: 4.57 oz/yd² (155 g/m²)
• Single jersey
• Set-in sleeves
• 1×1 rib at collar
• Narrow double-needle topstitch on the sleeves and bottom hems
